title: Later Mughals Farrukhsiyar
definition: Farrukhsiyar (reigned 1713–1719) was the ninth Mughal Emperor, whose reign marked the consolidation of the 'Kingmaker' era and the irreversible decline of central Mughal authority.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the transition from Mughal hegemony to British colonial dominance, specifically the 1717 Farman and the rise of the Sayyid Brothers.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Later Mughals Farrukhsiyar.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Early British East India Company expansion
